speaker: Monica
text: Rachel, calm down! We'll figure this out. Maybe it's just a minor outage.

speaker: Joey
text: Can we just blame it on the landlord? He's always trying to screw us over.

speaker: Chandler
text: This is so stupid. I was right in the middle of playing my new video game.

speaker: Ross
text: Wait, did you guys hear that? The fire alarm just went off! We need to get out of here, now!

speaker: Phoebe
text: Ugh, this is disgusting! Look at all the mold growing on the walls!

speaker: Joey
text: What's going on with Monica and Chandler? They're being super secretive lately.

speaker: Rachel
text: I know, it's really weird. I tried to talk to Monica about it, but she just brushed it off.

speaker: Ross
text: I've been noticing it too. It's like they're trying to hide something. And what's with all the 'we're just friends' nonsense?

speaker: Monica
text: What's the big deal? We're just not ready to share it with everyone yet.

speaker: Joey
text: But why do you guys have to be so secretive? It's like you're hiding something.

speaker: Chandler
text: Surprise! We're engaged! We were waiting for the perfect moment to reveal it, and now's the perfect time.

speaker: Rachel
text: Oh no, I'm so worried about the rent being late again.

speaker: Monica
text: I know, it's been a struggle lately.

speaker: Joey
text: Guys, stop worrying, it's just money.

speaker: Chandler
text: You're not taking this seriously, Joey. We're going to get evicted!

speaker: Phoebe
text: Okay, let's not fight about this. We can just talk about it.

speaker: Monica
text: I'm really scared we're going to lose our apartment.

speaker: Joey
text: Oh man, I'm really nervous about my parents coming to visit. They're gonna be all over me about getting a'real job'.

speaker: Chandler
text: I feel you, Joey. I'm worried about my dad's expectations too. He thinks I should be a lawyer or something.

speaker: Monica
text: Wait, what's going on? You're both getting visited by your parents? That's crazy! I'm a bit surprised.

speaker: Rachel
text: Ugh, this is disgusting. I can already imagine my mom judging me for not having a boyfriend.

speaker: Ross
text: You guys are all so dramatic. I'm angry about it because I'm stuck with my parents' expectations too. They think I should be a professor or something.

speaker: Phoebe
text: Well, I think we should all just relax and be ourselves. Our parents will come around eventually.
